## Supplemental PR & Issue Labels

When categorizing automated Pull Requests or triaged issues, apply only the repository's standard labels:

- `automated-pr`: Applied to all agentic workflow Pull Requests.
- `documentation`: Applied to Sphinx, README, docstring, or architecture doc updates.
- `tests` / `coverage`: Applied to unit test and coverage expansion Pull Requests.
- `dependencies`: Applied to Python, C++, or GitHub Actions dependency updates.
- `auto-sync`: Opt-in maintainer label indicating an open PR should be kept in sync with `main`.
- `bug`, `needs-info`, `triaged`: Applied by bug-report intake triage workflows.
